caption: Willemstoren, Bonaire
composition: White column and one red stripe on the rocky south point · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Willemstoren stands on the rocky southern tip of Bonaire, a white round stone column with one narrow red stripe and a small beacon on the gallery. A low ruined keeper house sits beside it, and the sea is dark. The sky is clear, about 28.4°C, with wind near 22.9 km/h and cloud cover about 11%. The salt pans are a different scene, and the water is not shown pink.
